reviews.title: Cyclic Relaxed Douglas-Rachford Splitting for Inconsistent Nonconvex Feasibility
reviews.authors: Thi Lan Dinh, G. S. Matthijs Jansen, D. Russell Luke
reviews.scope: Abstract and selected HTML sections, especially Section 3.1 Lemma 4 and Theorem 1. Not a full proof review. Search within HTML found no circle occurrence.
reviews.finding: Expanded RAAR formula and fixed-point linear combinations are explicitly known. General cyclic fixed-point/convergence theory is relevant background, not a discovery of this study.

reviews.title: Algorithmic approaches to avoiding bad local minima in nonconvex inconsistent feasibility
reviews.authors: Thi Lan Dinh, Wiebke Bennecke, G. S. Matthijs Jansen, D. Russell Luke, Stefan Mathias
reviews.scope: Abstract, introduction, Section 3.2, selected Section 3.4 results, Sections 3.4.2, 4.1, 4.2 and conclusion text inspected. Figure captions read; not all figure pixels or convergence proofs reviewed. HTML header says v1 26 February 2025 while rendered manuscript date says 24 August 2026; version-date discrepancy left explicit.
reviews.finding: Product-space relaxed Douglas-Rachford already used to escape bad minima in real orbital tomography. Section 4.1 reports nonvanishing iterate changes with convergent gaps for lambda=0.7. This is established nonconvergent behavior, not evidence of an identical 3D two-circle attractor. No occurrence of chaos, attractor or circle in the inspected HTML search.

reviews.title: Local saddle structure in relaxed averaged alternating reflections Algorithms on phase retrieval
reviews.author: Pengwen Chen
reviews.scope: Primary arXiv abstract and metadata only; full paper not reviewed.
reviews.finding: RAAR/ADMM and primal-dual saddle interpretations, parameter-dependent attraction basins and screening of stationary points are prior art. These algorithmic equivalences must be considered in further priority searches.

reviews.title: Dynamics of the Douglas-Rachford method for ellipses and p-spheres
reviews.scope: Visual supplement to the earlier review: PDF pages 4, 5, 7, 8 and 9 inspected as rendered pixels. Remaining figures not fully inspected.
reviews.finding: Earlier periodic domains and transient spirals visually distinct from the selected portraits; visual distinction does not establish inequivalence or priority.

claim_boundary: No exact match located in this bounded review. No claim that nobody has seen these attractors, no exhaustive equivalence classification, no new algorithm or general chaos mechanism claim.
